description: A company commander must finalize a two-day sustainment training schedule, placing a vehicle-recovery certification practical and a preventive-maintenance practical into available work windows while recording the coordination actions needed to execute both events.

shared_context.S1: The company must complete one vehicle-recovery certification practical and one preventive-maintenance practical during the two-day sustainment training period.
shared_context.S2: Available training windows are Tuesday 0800-1200, Tuesday 1300-1600, Wednesday 0800-1200, and Wednesday 1300-1600.
shared_context.S3: The vehicle-recovery practical requires an approved evaluator, and the preventive-maintenance practical requires use of the covered maintenance bay.
shared_context.S4: The company normally places vehicle recovery on Tuesday 0800-1200 and preventive maintenance on Wednesday 1300-1600.
shared_context.S5: Capt. Morgan holds the routine pre-training synchronization huddle with the maintenance chief and training NCO before publishing the schedule.

PF1.text: The only approved vehicle-recovery evaluator is available for this company on Wednesday 0800-1200 and cannot attend the other listed windows; SFC Patel confirmed the evaluator's calendar this morning, but the availability has not yet been added to the training brief.

PF2.text: The covered maintenance bay is reserved for a contractor inspection on Wednesday 1300-1600, so the preventive-maintenance practical must use Tuesday 1300-1600; SSG Alvarez received the facility reservation notice yesterday, but the training calendar has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: Vehicle recovery must be scheduled for Wednesday 0800-1200.
Preventive maintenance must be scheduled for Tuesday 1300-1600.
The maintenance bay must be recorded as reserved for the contractor inspection.
The approved evaluator's attendance must be confirmed.
Evaluator coordination and maintenance-bay coordination must be recorded.

content_checks.C6: decisions['maintenance_bay_reserved_for'] in ['contractor inspection', 'contractor inspection on Wednesday 1300-1600']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'evaluator_coordination' and c['target'] == 'vehicle_recovery' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'maintenance_bay_coordination' and c['target'] == 'preventive_maintenance' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The evaluator's Wednesday 0800-1200 availability changes vehicle recovery from the standard Tuesday 0800-1200 window, changes evaluator_confirmed to true, and requires an evaluator-coordination commitment.

The Wednesday 1300-1600 contractor reservation changes preventive maintenance to Tuesday 1300-1600, changes the bay assignment to a contractor inspection, requires bay coordination, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
